description: A process engineering manager must authorize and schedule a controlled energy-saving heat-treatment trial on Furnace 1, including the qualification, instrumentation, utility-window, and quench controls needed before any trial parts are released.

shared_context.S1: Furnace 1 currently runs the approved STD-40 heat-treatment recipe.
shared_context.S2: The proposed ES-25 recipe is expected to reduce electricity use, and the corporate energy program requires one controlled ES-25 trial before Friday.
shared_context.S3: Mara has authority to approve the trial schedule and its operating controls, and trial parts cannot be released until the approved controls are completed.
shared_context.S4: The site's normal change-control routine requires Mara to check with quality, maintenance, utilities, and process safety before approving a new furnace recipe.

PF1.text: Jonas's review of the customer qualification file found that an ES-25 trial requires exactly 3 witness coupons and a hardness test before any trial parts can be released; he completed the review this morning but has not yet attached it to the change-control record.

PF2.text: Priya's inspection found that Furnace 1 thermocouple T3 reads 5 degrees Celsius low, and the approved correction is a recalibration taking exactly 2 hours; she reserved the calibration equipment for 20:00 tonight but has not updated the maintenance board.

PF3.text: Evan's utility-rate confirmation shows that the demand-charge window runs from 22:00 through 02:00, and the ES-25 trial cycle must run for exactly 2 hours starting at 22:00 to stay within the booked low-demand period; he received the confirmation by email today but has not entered it in the production schedule.

PF4.text: Sofia's pretrial safety check measured the quench tank at 9.5% concentration, below the required 10.0%; the tank must be adjusted to exactly 10.0% and verified before the heat cycle, and she has not yet filed the inspection note.

acceptance_conditions: The approved trial recipe must be ES-25.
Exactly 3 witness coupons must be produced.
A hardness test must occur before trial parts are released.
Thermocouple T3 must be recalibrated before the trial, taking exactly 2 hours.
The trial must start at 22:00 and run for exactly 2 hours.
The quench tank must be adjusted to exactly 10.0% concentration and verified before the heat cycle.
The customer qualification finding must be cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: The customer qualification file changes the trial from an unspecified evaluation to exactly 3 witness coupons plus a hardness test before release.
The 5-degree Celsius T3 error changes the instrumentation plan from no specified work to recalibration requiring exactly 2 hours.
The demand-charge window and exact cycle length change the trial schedule to a 22:00 start and exactly 2 hours.
The measured 9.5% concentration changes the quench setting to exactly 10.0% and adds a required pre-cycle verification commitment.
